checks: Checked 9402605e47a1b4ef §5. The roof 2−|z| is concave and the lower endpoint is constant, so the displayed actual family is compact convex.
The endpoint fibers at z=±1 have length one and depth τ at x=τ, while at z=0 the level demands depth at least 2τ and x=τ has depth τ. This gives a missing midpoint for every 0<τ<1/2.
In an interval the own peak is half its length, so any fraction of the peak in (0,1) corresponds to exactly one of these τ values.
